scope: Read-only source/preparation/installed-SDK review. No W&B import/API invocation, live history read, model/simulator work, network or upload. Original evidence unchanged.

correctness_checks.result: Stage completed, successful finished attempt, expected cwd/workflow and exact completed report hash are required before importing W&B.

correctness_checks.name: History arithmetic
correctness_checks.result: 10739 full local training records at steps20..214780;2139 recovered records at172020..214780. Explicit unexpected/duplicate/pre-resume training rows are rejected.

correctness_checks.name: Remote identity
correctness_checks.result: Exact entity/project/run uxzgf780 and display name are checked; entity from saved managed log is explicit because protobuf field was empty.

correctness_checks.name: Metric matching
correctness_checks.result: All five recovered training metrics compared to exact local history at1e-12 tolerance, all11 expected validation step identities checked, final validation compared to train_state and remote summary. Intermediate validation values are only checked finite, not independently reconciled to separate checkpoint history.

correctness_checks.name: Temporal local checks
correctness_checks.result: Report/config/train_state/verifier bytes and completed stage are rechecked after API reads. Remote service is correctly called mutable rather than pinned.

correctness_checks.name: Exceptions
correctness_checks.result: Application exception output omits exception strings/transport details and does not print credential values. SDK authentication itself may prompt if absent.

findings.issue: No overall deadline. Installed HistoryScan calls ServiceApi.send_api_request without a timeout; Api(timeout=60) does not bound these history waits.
findings.recommendation: Use an independent hard process deadline and preserve safe failure output.

findings.issue: HistoryScan page_size is optimizer-step range width here. min_step0/page_size1000 causes215 service page reads,including172 empty pre-resume windows. These are not necessarily215 remote HTTP requests.
findings.recommendation: One sufficiently wide scan window still covering0..214780 preserves explicit no-pre-resume-record checking without redundant windows.

findings.issue: Managed state config_sha256 is not bound to the pinned recovery YAML. Individual local config/train_state bytes are stable but whole run-directory output hash is delegated to other audits.
findings.recommendation: Pin recipe bytes and require state config_sha256; retain separate final payload audit limitation.

findings.issue: Freshness alone permits output under a completed hashed run/results directory. The documented invocation is safe but CLI does not enforce it.
findings.recommendation: Require the exact fresh audit destination under runs/continuation-audit.

findings.issue: wandb.Api() without explicit api_key can enter interactive authentication; default host comes from environment/settings. This conflicts with existing-auth-only intent on missing credentials.
findings.recommendation: Require an existing nonempty key without printing it; pass explicitly and pin the expected api.wandb.ai host; no login/sync fallback.

limitations: This is static review, not proof the remote run finished or that logs fully synchronized.
API history may initialize a W&B SDK sidecar; no experiment run is created by the listed read methods.
Source/hash evidence is narrow; a separate final S2 audit must verify checkpoint structure and complete private payload.
planned_followup: Parent authorized a separate v2 helper; original v1 and preparation will be preserved byte-for-byte. No API execution authorized in this review.
